is_anopheles.evidence: Studies evaluated wild Anopheles arabiensis and colonized Anopheles gambiae s.s. in experimental huts (page 2, 'Methods'; page 9, 'Experiment 1 field').

reports_target_markers.evidence: PCR was performed only for species identification of the Anopheles gambiae complex (page 6, 'Mosquito handling and identification'; page 9, 'Experiment 1 field'). No target insecticide-resistance markers were genotyped.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No insecticide resistance marker genotype or allele data are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Field trials were conducted in Lupiro village, Kilombero valley, south-east Tanzania (page 3, 'Experiment 1: field - Study area').

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper is a primary empirical experimental hut study measuring entomological parameters and repellency/toxicity of DDT and airborne pyrethroids.

sub_country_location.evidence: Lupiro village in the Kilombero valley, south-east Tanzania (page 3, 'Study area').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field experiments were conducted between 24th November 2010 and 15th October 2011 (page 6, 'Mosquito collection').

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary experimental hut evaluation with original mosquito collection and release data.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary files are indicated as containing missing resistance marker genotype data.

assessment.summary: This study assesses the deterrence, excito-repellency, feeding inhibition, and mortality effects of DDT indoor residual spraying and airborne pyrethroid coils (transfluthrin and metofluthrin) on An. arabiensis in field experimental huts in Lupiro, Tanzania, and laboratory-reared An. gambiae s.s. in a semi-field system. No insecticide resistance target markers were genotyped.
exclusion_reasons: No target insecticide resistance markers were genotyped (PCR was only used for Anopheles gambiae complex species identification).
No extractable resistance marker genotype data are reported.
